svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The three directions side by side
svg.text: 01 · The three directions side by side
Use case: the session picks one; the same moment in each: 20:40, the groups of four are being played, the final is next
A · The mini tourney, moved in
Attendees: the same pages they know (season, bracket,
sign-up, report), now in the hub with sign-in
Organisers: the three admin pages ported into the shell, one
open season per event
Venue staff: the screen shows the three finals cards and
nothing between them
Trade-off: cheapest and proven; the screen and the phones stay
quiet while the bracket runs
Cost S–M
B · One app, two homes
Attendees: one Finals, online between events and at the LAN,
the same look in both
Organisers: one tool all year; the platform offers it sign-in,
storage and events
Venue staff: as C on the screen
Trade-off: designs the Apps track's interface before that
track's session; two sign-in models; waits on both codebases
Cost L–XL
C · Finals night (recommended)

g.text: Demo Finals · groups of four, live

svg.text: Attendees: join in seconds from the screen, the hub or Discord;
the team reveal; my match with its lobby code; report by
dragging; the champion moment
Organisers and crew: a season desk led by the next action, the
team builder, disputes, corrections with a reason, a crew
phone
Venue staff: the screen tells the story: open, teams drawn, the
bracket live, champion
Trade-off: more than A (events, Moments, Screen, a correction
rule); the bot and the hub's frame carry parts of it
Cost M
